scope: Read-only post-hoc diagnosis of every saved decay cell. No training, augmentation during training, reselection or replacement of primary scores.
equation: Evaluate residual F(x)-x and F(-x)+x, divide by original strength, and split into their half-difference and half-sum. Symmetric squared error is the sum of odd and even squared errors.
target: Odd component is the frozen original tanh residual. Even component is frozen mixed minus original residual, in FP64, retaining quantization in the original plus-side label. Reflect these components algebraically; no original target array changes.
denominator: Odd target energy plus even target energy on the same split. These additional symmetric probe metrics are distinct from the original held-out relative MSE and its threshold.
